verdicts.quote: "To implement authentication with OAuth 2.0, you need to create an OAuth app to get your Client ID and Client Secret."
verdicts.reason: OAuth 2.0 is a documented, first‑class auth method and is recommended for user‑facing, multi‑tenant integrations, so it’s the primary auth Composio would use. ([developer.close.com](https://developer.close.com/api/overview/oauth-authentication))

verdicts.quote: "Do I need to talk to sales? No. You can sign up, start a trial..."
